🚀 QUICK BUILD COMMANDS
════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════

METHOD A: EAS BUILD (Cloud - Easiest)
─────────────────────────────────────
$ cd c:\Users\Vichu\OneDrive\Desktop\UrbanHelpersApp
$ eas login
$ eas build --platform android --profile preview

Time: 10-15 minutes
Requires: Internet connection, Expo account

METHOD B: GRADLE BUILD (Local - Faster)
────────────────────────────────────────
$ cd c:\Users\Vichu\OneDrive\Desktop\UrbanHelpersApp\android
$ .\gradlew.bat assembleDebug    (or assembleRelease)

Time: 5-10 minutes (after first run)
Requires: Android SDK setup

METHOD C: BUILD SCRIPTS
───────────────────────
$ .\build-apk.ps1 -type release
$ .\build-apk.bat release

════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
📱 PHONE DEPLOYMENT (ADB)
════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════

1. ENABLE USB DEBUGGING (On Phone):
   Settings → About Phone → Build Number (tap 7x) 
   → Developer Options → USB Debugging ON

2. CONNECT PHONE:
   Use USB data cable
   Tap "Allow" on USB Debugging prompt

3. VERIFY CONNECTION:
   $ adb devices
   (Should show: deviceid  device)

4. INSTALL APK:
   $ adb install -r android\app\build\outputs\apk\debug\app-debug.apk

5. LAUNCH:
   App opens automatically or find "Urban Helpers" on home screen

════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
🔧 USEFUL COMMANDS
════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════

ADB:
  adb devices                    List connected devices
  adb install -r <apk>          Install APK
  adb uninstall <package>        Uninstall app
  adb logcat                     View device logs
  adb shell am start -n <pkg>    Launch app

NPM:
  npm install                    Install dependencies
  npm start                      Start Expo dev server
  npm run android                Launch in Android emulator

GRADLE:
  cd android
  .\gradlew.bat clean            Clean build
  .\gradlew.bat assembleDebug    Build debug APK
  .\gradlew.bat assembleRelease  Build release APK

EAS:
  eas login                      Login to Expo
  eas build --platform android   Build APK (cloud)
  eas build --status             Check build status
  eas logout                     Logout

════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
⚠️  TROUBLESHOOTING QUICK FIXES
════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════

"adb not found"
→ Add to PATH: C:\Users\Vichu\AppData\Local\Android\sdk\platform-tools

"Device offline/unauthorized"
→ adb kill-server
→ adb start-server
→ Tap "Allow" on phone

"Build timeout"
→ This is normal on first build, just wait

"Installation failed"
→ adb uninstall com.urbanhelpers.app
→ adb install -r <apk>

"App crashes"
→ adb logcat | Select-String "UrbanHelpers"

════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
🎬 TYPICAL WORKFLOW
════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════

First Build (15-20 min total):
  1. eas build --platform android --profile preview    [10-15 min]
  2. Enable USB Debugging on phone                      [30 sec]
  3. Connect phone via USB                              [1 min]
  4. adb install -r app.apk                             [2 min]
  5. Test on phone                                      [5 min]

Subsequent Builds (8-15 min):
  1. Make code changes
  2. eas build --platform android --profile preview    [10-15 min]
  3. adb install -r app.apk                             [2 min]
  4. Test on phone
